xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5310: Issue view says 'writing code' or 'planning' and 'No pull request yet' for every issue closed more than 14 days ago

plan.title: Issue view says 'writing code' or 'planning' and 'No pull request yet' for every issue closed more than 14 days ago
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Issues closed more than issues.closedWindowDays (14) days ago reach the server only through backfillIssue(), but pushUpdated() schedules the derived-state refresh only for the tracker poll rows, so a backfilled issue has no derived state and every issue-view section renders its 'nothing happened yet' default (writing code / planning / No pull request yet / Plan, Start work, Release). Even with a derived state the repo PR listing reaches only ~100 closed PRs (~9 days), so an aged-out merged PR is lost; deriveNarrative has no closed branch; isShipped treats closed + open PR as shipped; derivePipelineState returns 'generic' (Not started) without derived state; header primary actions ignore closed state; and readIssueFromTracker never tries GitHub when trackers.primary is linear, so pan show cannot see a closed GitHub issue.
narratives.Proposal: Server: include backfilledIssues in the derived refresh scheduled by pushUpdated (net-zero lines, file at cap) and read a backfilled issue's merged PR once per branch through a memoized, metered gh pr list --state merged --head call. CLI/lib: readIssueFromTracker reads GitHub first for an id resolveGitHubIssue maps. Frontend: deriveNarrative gets three closed cases (Shipped / Closed, but PR #N is still open — close or merge it / Closed); isShipped requires pr.merged; deriveShip shows the open PR with the zombie reason and a 'closed' status without a PR; derivePipelineState falls back to done for a tracker-done issue; closed issues get Reopen as the only primary action and no Release needs-you, Create PR link or pickup section. Document the rules in docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md and changelog.d/pan-5310.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not close or modify eltmon/lexerra#614; the operator closes it after verification.
- Do not widen the per-issue merged-PR read to issues inside the poll window (closed 9-14 days ago) or to non-backfilled issues.
- Do not change getCachedTrackerIssues() or the membership trigger's inputs.
- Do not widen the issuesRaw snapshot to rows the cycle filter drops.
- Do not add a new PipelinePhase member.
- Do not raise scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt or grow issue-data-service.ts past 1754 lines.
- Do not change pan show's output format; only its tracker read changes.
- Do not change pan show's CV outcome rule (deriveCvOutcome in src/cli/commands/show.ts still counts closed + any PR as success); the docs must not claim it reads pr.merged.

autoDecisions.summary: Schedule backfilled rows at the pushUpdated call site instead of changing getCachedTrackerIssues()
autoDecisions.rationale: getCachedTrackerIssues() feeds the PAN-5261 membership trigger, which must see raw tracker rows only.

autoDecisions.summary: Read a merged PR per branch only for backfilled issues, memoized for the process lifetime
autoDecisions.rationale: The closed PR listing covers ~9 days (measured: oldest 2026-11-05), so aged-out merged PRs are otherwise invisible; limiting to backfilled ids keeps GitHub quota cost to issues an operator opened.

autoDecisions.summary: Use gh pr list --state merged (not --state all) for the per-branch read
autoDecisions.rationale: Open PRs are already in the open listing and closed-unmerged PRs are dropped by prFromGhRow, so only a merged row changes the answer.

autoDecisions.summary: Closed issues get Reopen as their only primary action, implemented in getPhasePrimaryActions without a new PipelinePhase
autoDecisions.rationale: Required behaviour 4 keeps Reopen available; the MERGED phase's Close out primary is wrong for a closed issue, and new phase names would ripple through Kanban and badge maps.

autoDecisions.summary: readIssueFromTracker tries GitHub first for a GitHub-resolved id, then the configured trackers
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveGitHubIssue is an id-specific prefix mapping, which is more specific than the global tracker order.

autoDecisions.summary: Hide the whole Details pickup section for a closed issue, and add a 'closed' ship status for a closed issue with no PR
autoDecisions.rationale: Ready/Park/Release have no meaning for a closed issue, and 'No pull request yet' is false for a closed issue.
